description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing slot reservations, including endpoints for retrieving available slots, reserving, updating, retrieving, and deleting slot reservations, specifically for API version 2024-09-04.

classes.name: SlotsController_2024_09_04
classes.description: NestJS controller handling slot-related API endpoints for version 2024-09-04, including fetching available slots, reserving, retrieving, updating, and deleting slot reservations.

methods.name: getAvailableSlots
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available time slots based on various query parameters.

methods.name: reserveSlot
methods.description: Handles POST requests to reserve a slot, with optional user authentication.

methods.name: getReservedSlot
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific reserved slot by UID.

methods.name: updateReservedSlot
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update an existing reserved slot by UID.

methods.name: deleteReservedSlot
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a reserved slot by UID.
